records.select_all.description: The checkbox at the head of a table of records (reports, accounts, jobs in the staff's screens) that checks every row shown, or unchecks them all; shown beside it on a phone, read to assistive technology at every width.

records.select_row.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the checkbox at the start of a row of a table of records, which picks the row for an action on all the rows picked: name is what the row's head shows (an account's handle, a domain, a job's name).

records.selected.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {選択なし} other {# 件を選択中}}
records.selected.description: Above a table of records, beside the actions that act on every row picked: how many rows are picked; also read to assistive technology as it changes.

records.facet.description: A filter of a list in the staff's screens while a value of it is applied, on its button: facet is what it filters by (State, Category), value the value applied (Open, Spam).

records.clear_filters.description: After the filters over a list in the staff's screens, while any is applied: removes every filter and empties the search, showing the whole list again.

records.pages.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the navigation under a long list paged by cursor (reports, accounts, a staff queue) that moves to the page before or after.

records.page.description: Between Previous and Next under a long list paged by cursor: which page of it is shown, counted from the first (the server gives no total, so no 'of N'); also read to assistive technology as it changes.

records.previous.description: Under a long list, moves to the page before the one shown (newer records, in a list of the latest first).

records.next.description: Under a long list, moves to the page after the one shown (older records, in a list of the latest first).

records.page_failed.defaultMessage: このページを読み込めませんでした。
records.page_failed.description: Over Previous and Next under a long list, when the page asked for could not be read; the button that asked for it reads Try again (records.retry) meanwhile.

records.more.description: Under a list that grows in place (a table of records, a list inside a detail or the settings), adds the next items under those shown.

records.more_failed.defaultMessage: 一覧の続きを読み込めませんでした。
records.more_failed.description: Over Show more under a list that grows in place, when its next items could not be read; the button reads Try again (records.retry) meanwhile.

records.retry.description: The button under a list in place of Previous, Next or Show more after it failed (records.page_failed, records.more_failed): asks for the same items again.

records.sort_by.description: The name of the menu that a narrow table of records (the staff's screens on a phone) opens to choose the column it is sorted by and the direction; also shown on its button while the table is sorted by none.

records.ascending.description: In the sort menu of a table of records: sorts it from the least to the most (A to Z, oldest first); also read after the sorted column's name on the menu's button.

records.descending.description: In the sort menu of a table of records: sorts it from the most to the least (Z to A, newest first); also read after the sorted column's name on the menu's button.
